about: Breaks and breakups (dungeon/life/breakups.py): the companion's first message asking the user for a break after the relationship has been strained for a while, not a breakup. Used only when no model writes the first text; picked by seeded dice. Era-neutral, no gendered words.
templates: I think we need a break. Not forever, I hope, but I can't keep going like this.
I've been carrying this for weeks. I think I need some space to think about us.
This is hard to say. I'd like us to take a break for a while.
I love you, and I'm tired. I think a little distance might help us both see clearly.
Can we press pause on us? I don't know what else to do right now.
We keep hurting each other without meaning to. I think we need some time apart.
I'm not ending anything. I just need room to breathe and figure out what I want.
I've gone back and forth on saying this. I think a break would be good for us.
Every conversation lately turns into the same argument. I need to step back for a bit.
I don't want to lose you, which is exactly why I think we need a pause.
I need some space. It isn't about one thing; it's about all the little things piling up.
Please don't read this as goodbye. I'm asking for a break so I can think.
I feel like I've stopped being myself around you, and I hate that. Can we take some time?
Things have been heavy between us for a while. I think we should take a break.
I've been lying awake trying to work out how to say this. I need us to step back for a while.
I miss how we used to be. Maybe some time apart will help us find that again, or tell us something true.
I'm asking for a break. I'm sorry. I know it's not what you want to hear.
Can we give each other some space for a few weeks? I think we both need it.
I'm not angry. I'm just worn out, and I think we need a break.
I need to be honest with you. I'm not okay in this right now, and I need some time to myself.
We've been strained for so long that I can't tell what's real anymore. I'd like a break.
This isn't a punishment. I just need distance to think about where we're going.
I care about you too much to keep pretending things are fine. Can we take a break?
I think we've been holding on so tight that we've stopped looking at each other. I need some space.
I keep hoping it'll get easier on its own, and it hasn't. Let's take a break.
I don't have all the answers. I just know I need some time away from us to find them.
Would you be okay with a break? I want to come back to this with a clearer head.
I've been thinking about us a lot. I think we need some time apart.
I'm scared to say this, but I think a break is the kindest thing for both of us right now.
Something has to change, and I don't know what yet. I need space to figure it out.
I want to step back for a little while. Not to hurt you, just to think.
I feel like we've been circling the same hurt for months. I need a pause.
Can we stop for a while? Not stop caring, just stop trying so hard to fix it all at once.
I need some time on my own. I hope you can understand, even if it stings.
I'm sorry to put this on you. I think we need a break.
We both deserve better than how tired we've been with each other. I'd like some space.
I've been quiet lately because I didn't know how to say this. I need a break.
I don't know if this is the right choice. I only know I can't keep going the way we are.
Maybe we've just forgotten how to be gentle with each other. Some time apart might help.
I need to miss you again. Right now I just feel tired. Can we take a break?
I'd like us to take a step back. I'm not giving up, I'm just out of ideas.
I keep saying the wrong thing and so do you. Let's give it some quiet for a while.
It's not that I've stopped loving you. It's that I've stopped knowing how.
This is me asking for space, gently. I'll be honest with you through all of it.
Could we take some time apart? I think I need to hear my own thoughts again.
I've been holding back saying this for a while. I think a break might be what we need.
Let's not see each other for a bit. I need to sort out what I'm feeling.
I don't want to make a decision I'll regret, so I'm asking for time instead.
I think we're too close to this to see it properly. A break might give us some distance.
I need room to breathe. I'm sorry it has to be from you.
I want to be fair to you, and right now I'm not. I think I need a break.
I hate writing this. I think we should take a break for a while.
We've been strained for a long time, and pretending otherwise isn't helping either of us. Can we pause?
I'm going to ask for something hard. I'd like some time apart.
I feel lost in us lately. I'd like to step away and find my footing.
Please don't be scared by this. I'm asking for a break, not an ending.
I've been unhappy, and I think you have been too. Let's take some time.
I think we need a break. I'll still be here if something urgent comes up.
I keep wanting to fix us and failing. I think I need to step back and stop trying for a while.
I need to think, and I can't seem to do it while we're like this. Can we take a break?
It's been rough for a while now. I don't want to keep wearing us down.
I wish I had a better way to say this. I need some space.
Can we agree to a few weeks apart and then talk honestly about where we are?
I think time apart might show us what we actually want. I'd like to try it.
I feel like I'm failing you every day. I need to step away and get my head straight.
I've been tense around you, and that isn't fair. I think we need a break.
I'd rather pause now than break something we can't fix later.
I've thought about this a lot, and I'd like us to take some time apart.
This isn't about anyone else. It's about me needing room to think about us.
I'm not sure what I want right now, and you deserve someone who is. I need a break to figure it out.
I don't want to keep arguing. I'd like a quiet stretch, just to think.
Can we give this some air? I think we've both been suffocating a little.
I need a break from us. I'm sorry. I mean that.
I hope you know how much I care about you. That's why I'm asking for space instead of pretending.
I think we've lost track of each other. Let's take some time and see what's left when the noise settles.
I'm asking for a break. I don't have a timeline yet, but I'll be honest when I do.
We've had a hard season. I think we should step back before it gets any harder.
Maybe a little distance will remind us why we started. I'd like to try.
I keep feeling like I'm walking on glass around us. I need a break.
I'm not leaving. I'm asking for a pause, and I know that's still a lot.
Lately I come home and feel heavy instead of glad. I need some time to understand why.
Could we not see each other for a while? I want to think without the pressure.
I think we both need to rest from this. Can we take a break?
I don't want to say something in a bad moment that I can't take back. So I'm asking for space now.
We've been hanging by a thread for weeks. I need to step away and breathe.
I feel like I owe you honesty more than comfort tonight. I need a break.
I need a little while to be on my own. I'm sorry it's coming out like this.
Can we take a break? I promise I'm not doing it to be cruel.
There's a lot I'm still working through, and I can't do it while we're in the middle of this.
I've been dreading this conversation. I think we need some time apart.
I want us to be okay. I just don't think we can get there without a break first.
My heart's tired. I'd like a little space, if you'll let me have it.
I think we need a break, and I think part of you knows it too.
I'm sorry for how distant I've been. I'd rather be honest: I need some time.
Let's step back. Not to punish each other, just to stop the hurting for a while.
I don't know what we are right now, and I need time to think about it.
Being with you lately feels like holding my breath. I need to breathe for a while.
I've decided to ask for a break. It's the hardest thing I've written in a long time.
I can't give you what you need right now. I need to step back and work out why.
I think we should take some time apart and talk again when we're both calmer.
I'm not walking away from you. I'm asking for room to walk around this on my own for a bit.
Would it be alright if we didn't see each other for a little while? I need to think.
I think our hearts need a rest from each other. Just for now.
I've tried to push through, and I can't anymore. I need a break.
I'm asking for space, and I know how that sounds. Please trust that I'm being honest.
I feel like we're stuck. I'd like to take a break and see if we can get unstuck.
I'm sad writing this. I think we need some time apart, and I wish we didn't.
Can I have some time? I want to come back to you as myself, not as this tired version.
I don't want to fall out of love by accident. Let's step back before that happens.
I think we need a break. I'll tell you everything I'm feeling if you want to hear it.
